svg.title: Each logical box mapped to the files that implement it, with each file's change axis
svg.desc: Twenty-three logical boxes, in four groups — Load, Generate, Encode and Encode an image — each with the files that implement it and the axis each file changes on. Twelve boxes span more than one axis and split into files on different axes: Pick, Preflight, Gates, Upload, KV cache, Prefill and Decode, Emit, Encode, Read back, Vision step, Place, and Companion load. Files are coloured by layer: JavaScript, C++ core, or the WASM boundary.
svg.text: Files, and the axis each changes on
spans more than one change axis, so its files split
A file in more than one row serves several boxes, always on its one axis.
